(module asl-syntax/registry
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  :x [languageOf
      languageByExtension
      languageByShebang
      languageByMarkdownInfo
      languageByHtmlType
      languageByMime
      extensionOf]
  :i [(asl-syntax/core/source :a src)])

fn trimLeadingDots s: String -> String
  (if (stringStartsWith? s ".")
    (trimLeadingDots (optionOr (stringSlice s 1 (stringLength s)) ""))
    s)

fn extensionOf path: String -> String
  (let [(base (optionOr (listLast (stringSplit path "/")) ""))
        (stem (trimLeadingDots base))
        (parts (stringSplit stem "."))]
    (if (> (listLength parts) 1)
      (str "." (stringToLower (optionOr (listLast parts) "")))
      ""))

fn extLangOf ext: String -> String
  (cond
    ((= ext ".asl") "asl")
    ((= ext ".asn") "asn")
    ((or (= ext ".ts") (= ext ".tsx") (= ext ".mts") (= ext ".cts")) "typescript")
    ((or (= ext ".js") (= ext ".jsx") (= ext ".mjs") (= ext ".cjs")) "javascript")
    ((or (= ext ".py") (= ext ".pyw")) "python")
    ((= ext ".go") "go")
    ((= ext ".rs") "rust")
    ((or (= ext ".c") (= ext ".h")) "c")
    ((= ext ".java") "java")
    ((or (= ext ".sh") (= ext ".bash") (= ext ".zsh")) "shell")
    ((= ext ".md") "markdown")
    ((= ext ".json") "json")
    ((or (= ext ".yaml") (= ext ".yml")) "yaml")
    ((= ext ".toml") "toml")
    ((= ext ".swift") "swift")
    ((= ext ".rb") "ruby")
    ((= ext ".kt") "kotlin")
    ((or (= ext ".cpp") (= ext ".cc") (= ext ".hpp")) "cpp")
    ((or (= ext ".m") (= ext ".mm")) "objc")
    ((= ext ".zig") "zig")
    ((= ext ".lua") "lua")
    ((= ext ".pl") "perl")
    ((= ext ".php") "php")
    ((= ext ".ps1") "powershell")
    ((or (= ext ".html") (= ext ".htm")) "html")
    ((= ext ".css") "css")
    ((or (= ext ".xml") (= ext ".svg")) "xml")
    ((= ext ".sql") "sql")
    ((= ext ".wasm") "wasm")
    (else ""))

fn languageByExtension ext: String -> String
  (let [(n (stringToLower (stringTrim ext)))]
    (if (stringEmpty? n)
      ""
      (extLangOf (if (stringStartsWith? n ".") n (str "." n)))))

fn digitByte? c: Int64 -> Bool
  (and (>= c 48) (<= c 57))

fn versionRestOk bs: Bytes n: Int64 i: Int64 -> Bool
  (if (>= i n)
    true
    (let [(c (bytesGet bs i))]
      (if (or (digitByte? c) (= c 45) (= c 46) (= c 95))
        (versionRestOk bs n (+ i 1))
        false)))

fn versionTailGo bs: Bytes n: Int64 i: Int64 -> Bool
  (if (>= i n)
    false
    (let [(c (bytesGet bs i))]
      (cond
        ((digitByte? c) (versionRestOk bs n (+ i 1)))
        ((= c 118)
          (if (>= (+ i 1) n)
            false
            (if (digitByte? (bytesGet bs (+ i 1)))
              (versionRestOk bs n (+ i 2))
              false)))
        (else false))))

fn versionTail? rest: String -> Bool
  (let [(bs (stringToBytes rest))
        (n (bytesLength bs))]
    (if (= n 0)
      false
      (let [(c0 (bytesGet bs 0))]
        (versionTailGo bs n (if (or (= c0 45) (= c0 46) (= c0 95)) 1 0)))))

fn shebangMatches? low: String base: String -> Bool
  (if (not (stringStartsWith? low base))
    false
    (let [(rest (optionOr (stringSlice low (stringLength base) (stringLength low)) ""))]
      (if (stringEmpty? rest)
        true
        (versionTail? rest))))

fn matchShebang low: String -> String
  (cond
    ((shebangMatches? low "python") "python")
    ((shebangMatches? low "perl") "perl")
    ((shebangMatches? low "ruby") "ruby")
    ((shebangMatches? low "bash") "shell")
    ((shebangMatches? low "dash") "shell")
    ((shebangMatches? low "zsh") "shell")
    ((shebangMatches? low "ksh") "shell")
    ((shebangMatches? low "node") "javascript")
    ((shebangMatches? low "sh") "shell")
    (else ""))

fn baseName w: String -> String
  (optionOr (listLast (stringSplit w "/")) "")

fn keepWords s: String -> (List String)
  (fold (fn [(acc (List String)) (w String)] -> (List String)
          (if (stringEmpty? w) acc (listAppend acc w)))
        (list)
        (stringSplit s " "))

fn firstNonFlag words: (List String) idx: Int64 -> String
  (if (>= idx (listLength words))
    ""
    (let [(w (optionOr (listGet words idx) ""))]
      (if (stringStartsWith? w "-")
        (firstNonFlag words (+ idx 1))
        w)))

fn alnumGo bs: Bytes n: Int64 i: Int64 acc: String -> String
  (if (>= i n)
    acc
    (let [(c (bytesGet bs i))]
      (alnumGo bs n (+ i 1)
        (if (or (digitByte? c) (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90)) (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122)))
          (strConcat acc (stringFromCharCode c))
          acc)))))

fn alnumOnly name: String -> String
  (let [(bs (stringToBytes name))]
    (alnumGo bs (bytesLength bs) 0 ""))

fn shebangLangOf head: String -> String
  (let [(words (keepWords head))]
    (if (listEmpty? words)
      "shebang.empty"
      (let [(w0 (optionOr (listGet words 0) ""))]
        (let [(word (if (= (baseName w0) "env")
                      (firstNonFlag words 1)
                      w0))]
          (if (stringEmpty? word)
            "shebang.empty"
            (let [(name (baseName word))
                  (m (matchShebang (stringToLower name)))]
              (if (= m "")
                (let [(a (alnumOnly name))]
                  (str "shebang." (if (stringEmpty? a) "empty" a)))
                m)))))))

fn lineEnd b: Bytes limit: Int64 i: Int64 -> Int64
  (if (>= i limit)
    limit
    (if (= (bytesGet b i) 10)
      i
      (lineEnd b limit (+ i 1))))

fn buildText b: Bytes i: Int64 e: Int64 acc: String -> String
  (if (>= i e)
    acc
    (buildText b (+ i 1) e (strConcat acc (stringFromCharCode (bytesGet b i))))))

fn shebangHead b: Bytes -> String
  (let [(n (bytesLength b))]
    (if (< n 2)
      ""
      (if (not (and (= (bytesGet b 0) 35) (= (bytesGet b 1) 33)))
        ""
        (let [(limit (if (< n 256) n 256))]
          (buildText b 2 (lineEnd b limit 2) "")))))

fn languageByShebang line: String -> String
  (if (not (stringStartsWith? line "#!"))
    ""
    (let [(head (optionOr (stringSlice line 2 (stringLength line)) ""))]
      (let [(nl (stringIndexOf head "
"))]
        (shebangLangOf (if (>= nl 0) (optionOr (stringSlice head 0 nl) "") head)))))

fn languageOf path: String -> String
  (if (not (fileExists? path))
    "text"
    (let [(b (fileRead path))
          (kind (src/binaryKindBytes b))]
      (if (!= kind "")
        kind
        (let [(head (shebangHead b))]
          (if (!= head "")
            (shebangLangOf head)
            (let [(l (extLangOf (extensionOf path)))]
              (if (= l "") "text" l)))))))

fn mdMap word: String -> String
  (cond
    ((or (= word "python") (= word "py") (= word "py3") (= word "python3") (= word "ipython")) "python")
    ((or (= word "javascript") (= word "js") (= word "jsx") (= word "node")) "javascript")
    ((or (= word "typescript") (= word "ts") (= word "tsx")) "typescript")
    ((or (= word "sh") (= word "bash") (= word "zsh") (= word "shell")) "shell")
    ((= word "c") "c")
    ((or (= word "cpp") (= word "c++")) "cpp")
    ((= word "objc") "objc")
    ((= word "java") "java")
    ((or (= word "kotlin") (= word "kt")) "kotlin")
    ((= word "swift") "swift")
    ((or (= word "ruby") (= word "rb")) "ruby")
    ((or (= word "go") (= word "golang")) "go")
    ((or (= word "rust") (= word "rs")) "rust")
    ((= word "zig") "zig")
    ((= word "lua") "lua")
    ((= word "perl") "perl")
    ((= word "php") "php")
    ((or (= word "powershell") (= word "ps1") (= word "pwsh")) "powershell")
    ((= word "sql") "sql")
    ((= word "json") "json")
    ((or (= word "yaml") (= word "yml")) "yaml")
    ((= word "toml") "toml")
    ((or (= word "markdown") (= word "md")) "markdown")
    ((= word "html") "html")
    ((= word "css") "css")
    ((= word "xml") "xml")
    ((= word "wasm") "wasm")
    ((= word "asl") "asl")
    ((= word "asn") "asn")
    ((or (= word "text") (= word "txt")) "text")
    (else ""))

fn languageByMarkdownInfo info: String -> String
  (let [(words (keepWords (stringTrim info)))]
    (if (listEmpty? words)
      ""
      (mdMap (stringToLower (optionOr (listGet words 0) "")))))

fn languageByHtmlType t: String -> String
  (let [(n (stringToLower (stringTrim t)))]
    (cond
      ((or (= n "text/javascript") (= n "application/javascript") (= n "application/x-javascript") (= n "module") (= n "text/jsx")) "javascript")
      ((or (= n "text/typescript") (= n "application/typescript")) "typescript")
      ((= n "text/css") "css")
      ((or (= n "application/json") (= n "importmap")) "json")
      ((= n "text/html") "html")
      ((= n "application/wasm") "wasm")
      (else "")))

fn languageByMime m: String -> String
  (let [(n (stringToLower (stringTrim m)))]
    (cond
      ((or (= n "application/javascript") (= n "text/javascript") (= n "application/ecmascript")) "javascript")
      ((or (= n "application/typescript") (= n "text/typescript")) "typescript")
      ((or (= n "text/x-python") (= n "application/x-python-code") (= n "text/python")) "python")
      ((or (= n "text/x-shellscript") (= n "application/x-sh") (= n "application/x-shellscript")) "shell")
      ((or (= n "text/x-c") (= n "text/x-csrc")) "c")
      ((= n "text/x-c++src") "cpp")
      ((or (= n "text/x-rust") (= n "application/rust")) "rust")
      ((= n "text/x-go") "go")
      ((= n "text/x-java") "java")
      ((= n "text/x-kotlin") "kotlin")
      ((= n "text/x-swift") "swift")
      ((= n "text/x-ruby") "ruby")
      ((= n "text/x-zig") "zig")
      ((= n "text/x-lua") "lua")
      ((= n "text/x-perl") "perl")
      ((= n "text/x-php") "php")
      ((or (= n "text/x-powershell") (= n "application/x-powershell")) "powershell")
      ((= n "text/x-sql") "sql")
      ((= n "application/json") "json")
      ((or (= n "text/yaml") (= n "application/yaml")) "yaml")
      ((= n "application/toml") "toml")
      ((or (= n "text/markdown") (= n "text/x-markdown")) "markdown")
      ((= n "text/html") "html")
      ((= n "text/css") "css")
      ((or (= n "application/xml") (= n "text/xml")) "xml")
      ((= n "application/wasm") "wasm")
      ((= n "text/x-asl") "asl")
      ((= n "text/x-asn") "asn")
      (else "")))
